papers.title: Metal Ion Release from PEO-Coated Ti6Al4V DMLS Alloy for Orthopedic Implants
papers.abstract: This study investigates the influence of plasma electrolytic oxidation (PEO) on corrosion resistance of Ti6Al4V alloys produced by direct metal laser sintering (DMLS) for orthopedic implants. PEO (300 s) and flash-PEO (60 s) coatings containing Si, Ca, P, Mg and Zn were applied on both DMLS and wrought Ti6Al4V alloys. Samples, coated and uncoated, were characterized for microstructure, morphology and composition. Electrochemical behaviour was assessed by potentiodynamic polarization (PDP) and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) in simulated body fluid (SBF) at 37 °C. Ion release was quantified by inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES). DMLS alloy was more passive than wrought Ti6Al4V, releasing ~60% less Ti and ~25% less Al, but ~900% more V. For both alloys, correlation of corrosion current and ion release indicated that 98–99% of oxidized Ti remained in the passive layer. Flash-PEO produced uniform porous coatings composed of anatase and rutile with ~50% amorphous phase, while PEO yielded heterogeneous layers due to soft sparking. In both cases, coatings were the main source of ions. For the DMLS alloy, the best protection was afforded by flash-PEO, releasing 0.01 μg cm−2 d−1 Ti, 26 μg cm−2 d−1 Al, and 0.25 μg cm−2 d−1 V over 30 days.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究PEO涂层对DMLS Ti6Al4V腐蚀和离子释放的影响，未涉及任何力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical or fatigue testing; focus is solely on corrosion and ion release.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究PEO涂层对DMLS Ti6Al4V合金腐蚀和离子释放的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对DMLS和锻造Ti6Al4V进行PEO处理，通过PDP、EIS和ICP-OES表征。
summary_zh.result: DMLS合金钝化性更强，释放Ti和Al较少但V较多；flash-PEO涂层保护最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 电化学和离子释放实验验证了涂层性能。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the effect of plasma electrolytic oxidation (PEO) coatings on corrosion and ion release of DMLS Ti6Al4V for orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: PEO and flash-PEO coatings were applied on DMLS and wrought Ti6Al4V, characterized by microstructure, potentiodynamic polarization, EIS, and ICP-OES.
summary_en.result: DMLS alloy showed higher passivity with lower Ti and Al release but 900% more V release; flash-PEO provided the best protection with minimal ion release.
summary_en.validation: Electrochemical tests and ion release measurements in SBF validated the corrosion performance.

papers.title: Increased warping associated with lack of fusion porosity in additively manufactured PBFLB/Ti6Al4V cantilevers
papers.abstract: Abstract Powder Bed Fusion using a Laser Beam on Metals (PBF-LB/M) is one of the most widely used methods in the additive manufacturing of metals. This study used recommended process parameters on a commercial PBF-LB/M system to manufacture a series of cantilever specimens using the Ti6Al4V (ELI) alloy powder. During the manufacturing process, the material experienced residual stress (RS) causing cracking in some of the struts and resulting in warping, as expected for the cantilever specimens. The degree of warping indicated the amount of RS in the material and is a challenge for PBF-LB/M as-built parts. It is therefore important to study and minimize them as far as possible. Recently, post-processes, such as heat treatment and shot peening, are used to reduce RS. This paper reports on X-ray Computed Tomography (XCT) results acquired following the manufacturing process, showing an interesting correlation between lack of fusion (LOF) porosity and warping. The specimens were found to contain a range of different amounts of LOF porosity from 0.05 to 7.83%. It was observed that the increased LOF correlated with the increased warping in the series of cantilever specimens. It is reported that the previously contaminated protective window in the PBF-LB/M machine reduced the laser energy reaching the powder bed of specific parts, leading to the LOF porosity. With the support of numerical simulations, we propose that extensive LOF porosity is partly the cause for higher RS above the LOF pores due to reduced thermal dissipation, leading to stronger thermal gradients and more local RS and subsequent increased warping in the parts with higher amounts of LOF. This is the first reported observation of this interesting correlation between porosity and warping in additively manufactured metals.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文未涉及任何后处理工艺对Ti-6Al-4V力学性能影响的研究，仅讨论原始成型件的翘曲和孔隙率。
llm.why_not_core: No post-processing treatment is applied or studied; the paper focuses solely on as-built warping and porosity correlation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究PBF-LB/M制造Ti6Al4V悬臂梁时，熔合缺陷孔隙率与翘曲的关系。
summary_zh.method: 采用X射线计算机断层扫描（XCT）和数值模拟分析孔隙率与残余应力导致的翘曲。
summary_zh.result: 发现高熔合缺陷孔隙率与更大翘曲相关，归因于孔隙上方热耗散降低导致热梯度增大。
summary_zh.validation: 通过XCT实验测量孔隙率，并结合数值模拟验证相关性。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the correlation between lack-of-fusion porosity and warping in as-built PBF-LB/M Ti6Al4V cantilevers.
summary_en.method: X-ray computed tomography (XCT) and numerical simulations were used to analyze porosity and residual stress-induced warping.
summary_en.result: Increased lack-of-fusion porosity was correlated with greater warping, attributed to reduced thermal dissipation above pores leading to stronger thermal gradients.
summary_en.validation: Experimental XCT measurements of porosity were combined with numerical simulations to validate the observed correlation.
